question: How many sales reps do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_rep_count FROM ap.t_ppl WHERE is_sls = true;

question: What is our total invoiced revenue before tax to date?
sql: SELECT SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn) AS total_invoiced_revenue_excl_tax FROM sl.t_inv_lns l JOIN sl.t_inv i ON i.inv_id = l.inv_id WHERE i.inv_dt <= CURRENT_DATE;

question: How much stock on hand do we have in total across all products, in units?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qnt_on_hnd), 0) AS total_units_on_hand FROM wh.t_stc_itm_hld;

question: What is our total gross margin in dollars on everything we have invoiced?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ln_prf), 0) AS total_gross_margin FROM sl.t_inv_lns;

question: How many orders arrived late? Count an order as late when its confirmed delivery date is after the expected delivery date on the order.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id2) AS late_orders FROM sl.t_ord o JOIN sl.t_inv i ON i.ord_id2 = o.ord_id2 WHERE i.cnf_dlv_tm IS NOT NULL AND i.cnf_dlv_tm::date > o.exp_dlv_dt;

question: What is our total accounts receivable right now, meaning what customers still owe us?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ots_bln), 0) AS total_accounts_receivable FROM sl.t_cst_trn;

question: How much do we currently owe our vendors in total?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ots_bln), 0) AS total_owed_to_vendors FROM pu.t_spp_trn;

question: How many products need to be kept refrigerated?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refrigerated_products FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE is_chl_stc = true;

question: What promotions do we have on record? Show each promotion's description with its start date and end date.
sql: SELECT dl_dsc AS description, str_dt AS start_date, end_dt AS end_date FROM sl.t_spc_dls ORDER BY str_dt, end_dt, dl_dsc;

question: Which products are below their reorder point right now? Show the product name, the units on hand and the reorder point.
sql: SELECT i.stc_itm_nm AS product_name, h.qnt_on_hnd AS units_on_hand, h.rrd_lvl AS reorder_point FROM wh.t_stc_itm_hld h JOIN wh.t_stc_itm i ON i.stc_itm_id = h.stc_itm_id WHERE h.qnt_on_hnd < h.rrd_lvl ORDER BY i.stc_itm_nm;

question: How many customer orders came up short and had the remainder moved to a backorder?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_backorder FROM sl.t_ord WHERE bck_ord_ord_id IS NOT NULL;

question: How many of our products are made in Japan?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS japan_product_count FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE (cst_fld::jsonb ->> 'CountryOfManufacture') = 'Japan';

question: How many customers are in each customer category? Show the category name and the number of customers, and leave out categories with no customers.
sql: SELECT sc.cst_ctg_nm AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM sl.t_cst s JOIN sl.t_cst_ctg sc ON s.cst_ctg_id = sc.cst_ctg_id GROUP BY sc.cst_ctg_id, sc.cst_ctg_nm ORDER BY sc.cst_ctg_nm;

question: Which products are in the USB Novelties group? Just give me the product names.
sql: SELECT i.stc_itm_nm FROM wh.t_stc_grp g JOIN wh.t_stc_itm_stc_grp ig ON ig.stc_grp_id = g.stc_grp_id JOIN wh.t_stc_itm i ON i.stc_itm_id = ig.stc_itm_id WHERE g.stc_grp_nm = 'USB Novelties';

question: For each supplier we carry products from, show the supplier name and how many products we carry from them.
sql: SELECT s.spp_nm AS supplier_name, COUNT(i.stc_itm_id) AS product_count FROM pu.t_spp s JOIN wh.t_stc_itm i ON i.spp_id = s.spp_id GROUP BY s.spp_id, s.spp_nm ORDER BY s.spp_nm;

question: Who is the main contact at each supplier? Show the supplier name, the contact's full name and the contact's email address.
sql: SELECT s.spp_nm AS supplier_name, p.fll_nm AS contact_full_name, p.e_ml_add AS contact_email FROM pu.t_spp s JOIN ap.t_ppl p ON p.prs_id = s.prm_cnt_prs_id;

question: How many customers do we deliver to in each sales territory? Show the territory and the number of customers.
sql: SELECT sp.sls_trr AS sales_territory, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cst_id2) AS customer_count FROM sl.t_cst c JOIN ap.t_cts ct ON c.dlv_cit_yid = ct.cit_yid JOIN ap.t_stt_prv sp ON ct.stt_prv_id = sp.stt_prv_id GROUP BY sp.sls_trr ORDER BY sp.sls_trr;

question: What is our stock on hand worth for each product color, valued at last cost price? Show the color name and the value, and leave out products with no color.
sql: SELECT c.clr_nm AS color_name, SUM(h.qnt_on_hnd * h.lst_cst_prc) AS stock_value FROM wh.t_stc_itm_hld h JOIN wh.t_stc_itm i ON i.stc_itm_id = h.stc_itm_id JOIN wh.t_clr c ON c.clr_id = i.clr_id GROUP BY c.clr_nm ORDER BY c.clr_nm;

question: Which purchase orders are still open? Show the purchase order number, the supplier name and the expected delivery date.
sql: SELECT po.prc_ord_id AS purchase_order_number, s.spp_nm AS supplier_name, po.exp_dlv_dt AS expected_delivery_date FROM pu.t_prc_ord po JOIN pu.t_spp s ON s.spp_id = po.spp_id WHERE po.is_ord_fnl_d = false ORDER BY po.prc_ord_id;

question: How many invoices went to customers in each buying group? Show the buying group name and the number of invoices, and leave out customers who are not in a group.
sql: SELECT bg.byn_grp_nm AS buying_group, COUNT(i.inv_id) AS invoice_count FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_cst c ON c.cst_id2 = i.cst_id2 JOIN sl.t_byn_grp bg ON bg.byn_grp_id = c.byn_grp_id GROUP BY bg.byn_grp_id, bg.byn_grp_nm ORDER BY bg.byn_grp_nm;

question: How many units moved through the warehouse under each type of stock movement? Show the movement type name and the total quantity, with the sign as recorded.
sql: SELECT tt.trn_typ_nm AS movement_type, SUM(t.qnt) AS total_quantity FROM wh.t_stc_itm_trn t JOIN ap.t_trn_typ tt ON tt.trn_typ_id = t.trn_typ_id GROUP BY tt.trn_typ_id, tt.trn_typ_nm ORDER BY tt.trn_typ_nm;

question: How much have we paid each supplier in total? Show the supplier name and the amount paid as a positive number, for suppliers we have paid.
sql: SELECT s.spp_nm AS supplier_name, -SUM(t.trn_amn) AS amount_paid FROM pu.t_spp_trn t JOIN pu.t_spp s ON s.spp_id = t.spp_id JOIN ap.t_trn_typ tt ON tt.trn_typ_id = t.trn_typ_id WHERE tt.trn_typ_nm ILIKE '%payment%' OR tt.trn_typ_nm ILIKE '%remittance%' GROUP BY s.spp_id, s.spp_nm HAVING SUM(t.trn_amn) <> 0 ORDER BY amount_paid DESC;

question: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM sl.t_cst;

question: How many countries are in Europe?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cnt_id) AS european_countries FROM ap.t_cnt WHERE cnt = 'Europe';

question: What are the phone number and website of our supplier Contoso?
sql: SELECT spp_nm, phn_nmb, web_st_u_r_l FROM pu.t_spp WHERE spp_nm ILIKE '%Contoso%';

question: What is the recommended retail price of the USB rocket launcher (Gray)?
sql: SELECT s.rcm_rtl_prc FROM wh.t_stc_itm s LEFT JOIN wh.t_clr c ON s.clr_id = c.clr_id WHERE s.stc_itm_nm ILIKE 'USB rocket launcher%' AND (c.clr_nm ILIKE 'Gray' OR s.stc_itm_nm ILIKE '%(Gray)%');

question: How many temperature readings above 4.5 degrees has our refrigerated delivery vehicle logged?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings_above_4_5 FROM wh.t_vhc_tmp WHERE tmp > 4.5;

question: How many order lines are still waiting to be picked?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_lines_awaiting_pick FROM sl.t_ord_lns WHERE pck_cmp_d_whn IS NULL;

question: How many products have a lead time longer than 14 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE ld_tm_dys > 14;

question: What is the highest credit limit we have given any customer?
sql: SELECT MAX(crd_lmt) AS highest_credit_limit FROM ( SELECT crd_lmt FROM sl.t_cst UNION ALL SELECT crd_lmt FROM sl.t_cst_arc ) AS all_limits;

question: What was our gross margin in dollars in each calendar year, going by invoice date? Show the year and the margin.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt)::int AS year, SUM(l.ln_prf) AS gross_margin FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) ORDER BY year;

question: How many orders did we take in each month of 2015? Show the month number and the number of orders.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ord_dt)::int AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sl.t_ord WHERE ord_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND ord_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ord_dt) ORDER BY month_number;

question: By what percentage did invoiced revenue before tax grow from 2014 to 2015, going by invoice date? Round to one decimal place.
sql: SELECT ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2015 THEN l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2014 THEN l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2014 THEN l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn END) , 1) AS pct_growth FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) IN (2014, 2015);

question: How much money did we receive in customer payments between January 1 and March 31, 2016?
sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(t.trn_amn)) AS total_payments_received FROM sl.t_cst_trn t JOIN ap.t_trn_typ tt ON tt.trn_typ_id = t.trn_typ_id WHERE tt.trn_typ_nm ILIKE '%customer%payment%' AND t.trn_dt >= DATE '2016-01-01' AND t.trn_dt <= DATE '2016-03-31';

question: How many cold room temperature readings went above 4.5 degrees in February 2016?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings_above_4_5 FROM wh.t_cld_rm_tmp WHERE tmp > 4.5 AND rcr_whn >= TIMESTAMP '2016-02-01' AND rcr_whn < TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01';

question: Who were our top 5 customers by invoiced revenue before tax in 2015? Count each store on its own, not rolled up to its head office. Show the customer name and the revenue.
sql: SELECT c.cst_nm AS customer_name, SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn) AS revenue_before_tax FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id JOIN sl.t_cst c ON c.cst_id2 = i.cst_id2 WHERE i.inv_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY c.cst_id2, c.cst_nm ORDER BY revenue_before_tax DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which sales rep brought in the most invoiced sales including tax in 2015? Show their full name and the amount.
sql: SELECT p.fll_nm AS full_name, SUM(l.ext_prc) AS total_sales_including_tax FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id JOIN ap.t_ppl p ON p.prs_id = i.sls_prs_id WHERE i.inv_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY p.prs_id, p.fll_nm ORDER BY total_sales_including_tax DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are our top 10 products by units invoiced, all time? Show the product name and the units invoiced.
sql: SELECT si.stc_itm_nm AS product_name, SUM(il.qnt) AS units_invoiced FROM sl.t_inv_lns il JOIN wh.t_stc_itm si ON si.stc_itm_id = il.stc_itm_id GROUP BY si.stc_itm_id, si.stc_itm_nm ORDER BY units_invoiced DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What share of our invoiced revenue before tax comes from refrigerated products? Give it as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
sql: SELECT ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_chl_stc THEN l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn), 0), 2) AS refrigerated_revenue_pct FROM sl.t_inv_lns l JOIN wh.t_stc_itm s ON s.stc_itm_id = l.stc_itm_id;

question: Which employee has picked the most orders? Show their full name and the number of orders picked.
sql: SELECT fll_nm AS full_name, order_count FROM ( SELECT p.fll_nm, COUNT(*) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM sl.t_ord o JOIN ap.t_ppl p ON p.prs_id = o.pck_by_prs_id2 WHERE p.is_emp GROUP BY p.prs_id, p.fll_nm ) t WHERE rnk = 1;
